validated_work_order.approach: Add a deterministic Policy Kernel in src/policy/kernel.js (pure domain, no IO): ActionIntent validation against micro-limits and maturity bands, HMAC-signed capability issuance (tenant, resource, action, constraints, expiry, nonce, policy version), and validation that rejects expired, replayed (nonce store), over-scope and kill-switched capabilities with stable codes. Add kill-switch checks at global, tenant, provider and campaign levels plus a guardian loop (spend-spike and tracking-loss detectors) that freezes automation and records a persistent incident re-enabled only by explicit human action or the deterministic recovery policy. Add a per-action-class trust ledger (calibrated success minus false-intervention and downside penalties) driving autonomous-under-micro-limits vs approval vs shadow posture. Add the Executor as the sole credential holder executing only valid capabilities against typed Meta adapter writes (fake provider gains nonce-keyed write methods), idempotent on nonce with provider reconciliation and receipts. Persist capabilities/nonces, approvals, action records, kill switches, trust entries and incidents via a new migration plus repositories; expose approvals/guardian/execute routes; render the real approvals queue (impact, downside, evidence, expiry, approve/reject with reason, receipts, lapsed section) and a persistent guardian banner. Meta Ads only per the binding epic decision; Google Ads reuses this slice later.
assumptions: Seed script can be extended with one approval item, one receipt and one guardian incident fixture without breaking existing seeds
HMAC secret comes from env with a fixed dev default so CI and browser QA verify signatures deterministically
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Root cause is greenfield safety code following established repo patterns (pure domain modules, tenant-bound repositories, server-rendered five-state pages); main uncertainty is sizing one slice so the kernel, executor, guardian, trust ledger, approvals UI and fake-provider writes all land coherently.

files.change: Pure domain module: validate ActionIntent (quota/micro-limits, maturity band per action class), issue HMAC-signed capability {tenant, resource, action, constraints, expiry, nonce, policy_version}, validate capability rejecting EXPIRED_CAPABILITY, REPLAYED_NONCE, OVER_SCOPE, KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE with {code,message,details}; never imports sqlite, providers or credentials

Guardian detectors: spend-spike (observed spend vs baseline over window) and tracking-loss (no qualified events past freshness threshold) fixtures evaluate to freeze decisions; freeze sets provider/tenant kill switch and appends an incident; re-enable only via explicit human call or deterministic recovery predicate, never from strategy input

Per-action-class trust ledger math: score = calibrated success minus false-intervention and downside penalties from decision evaluations; posture thresholds map score to autonomous-under-micro-limits, approval-required or shadow; new-geography class pinned to shadow/approval until its own evidence accrues

Executor service: sole module allowed to hold mutation credentials; validates capability via kernel, dedupes on nonce (second delivery returns original receipt), calls typed provider writes, reconciles provider-reported state, records receipt plus drift (manual/platform/third-party) and audit event with actor and capability id

Add migration 005_safety_tables: capabilities/nonces (tenant, nonce PK, expiry, scope hash), approvals (tenant, approval_id PK, intent, impact/downside/evidence/expiry, status pending/approved/rejected/lapsed/executed, reason, receipt), action_records (tenant, receipt PK, nonce unique, reconciliation), kill_switches (scope PK global/tenant/provider/campaign, active, actor, reason), trust_ledger (tenant, action_class PK, score, posture), guardian_incidents (tenant, incident PK, kind, frozen_at, re-enabled) with append-only triggers on receipts/incidents

Add tenant-bound repositories for approvals, nonces/capabilities, action records, kill switches, trust ledger and guardian incidents; every query binds tenant_id; no update/delete on append-only tables
Add typed write interface WRITE_METHODS (updateBudget, setCampaignStatus, createDraft) with row/envelope validation mirroring the read contract; no version or error-code redefinition

Implement typed writes against in-memory fixture state keyed by capability nonce: duplicate nonce returns the stored receipt without re-applying; expose reconcile read returning provider-reported state for drift comparison

Add routes GET/POST /v1/approvals (list, request), POST /v1/approvals/:id/approve and /reject (reason required, failure keeps pending with reconciliation state), POST /v1/actions/execute (capability envelope, idempotent on nonce), GET /v1/guardian (freeze status and incidents) and POST /v1/guardian/re-enable (explicit human actor); kill-switch violations return 409 with stable codes in the {code,message} envelope

Approvals page reads the approvals repository: pending queue cards with impact, downside, evidence refs and expiry; approve/reject forms with reason field; executed receipts section; lapsed section for expired items (partial state); error shell keeps item pending with reconciliation copy; empty state keeps autonomy-posture table now rendered from the trust ledger. Add persistent guardian freeze banner to layout on every page while any kill switch is active

Wire approve/reject buttons to fetch POST with reason, success toast naming the receipt id, failure path keeps the card pending and announces reconciliation state via the live region; keep under 100-line vanilla style, DOM textContent only for stored data

out_of_scope: Google Ads adapter (later epic reuses this kernel per binding decision)
qa_script: npm run sdlc:seed && npm run sdlc:serve, then GET /health
Load /approvals: pending queue with impact/downside/evidence/expiry, approve one item with reason, confirm toast names the receipt id
Append ?state=partial to /approvals: lapsed section visible; ?state=error: item stays pending with reconciliation copy
Trigger spend-spike fixture: guardian banner on /, /journal and /approvals until POST /v1/guardian/re-enable
POST /v1/actions/execute twice with the same nonce: second returns original receipt without a second mutation
risks: Touches money movement, auth-equivalent capabilities and credential isolation: review must confirm no module outside src/executor imports mutation credentials or the HMAC secret
Kill-switch and guardian tables are new shared state: migration must stay additive and idempotent on existing databases
Fake-provider writes are test/simulation only; live.js must not gain real mutation calls beyond the typed interface in this slice

cases: expired capability rejects with EXPIRED_CAPABILITY
replayed nonce rejects with REPLAYED_NONCE and executes nothing
over-scope action rejects with OVER_SCOPE naming the violated constraint
capability under an active kill switch (each of global, tenant, provider, campaign) rejects with KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE
valid capability verifies and issues the signed envelope with all seven fields
spend-spike fixture freezes automation and records a persistent incident
tracking-loss fixture freezes automation and records a persistent incident
re-enable requires explicit human actor or the deterministic recovery predicate
writes refuse while frozen; read-only research paths keep serving
duplicate delivery of the same nonce executes exactly once against the fake provider
receipt carries reconciliation against provider-reported state
drift between requested and reported state is detected and recorded
manual/platform/third-party drift scenario writes a drift record
repeated safe outcomes raise the class posture to autonomous under micro-limits
one bad outcome collapses only that class, others unaffected
new-geography class stays in shadow or approval without its own evidence
approve transitions pending to executed with receipt id in response
reject requires reason and records actor
approval failure keeps the item pending with reconciliation state
expired approvals surface as lapsed, never vanish

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #20 is the safety slice of epic #14: every external write must flow ActionIntent to deterministic Policy Kernel to signed capability (tenant, resource, action, constraints, expiry, nonce, policy version) to Executor validation, with kill switches at global/tenant/provider/campaign levels, a per-action-class trust ledger, and an approvals queue plus guardian freeze UI. Nothing of this exists yet: the repo has the decision journal, measurement, Meta read adapter and fake provider, but no policy kernel, executor, approvals, kill switches, guardian or trust ledger. Binding decision: Meta Ads first, Google Ads later, so writes target the Meta adapter seam only.
